items.text: PARALAX orchestrates provider-independent agents. Parabiont carries task context. Axionorm authors and enforces YAML policies, using OPA for context and tool decisions.
Implement cross-model continuity from a user-reviewed ChatGPT project brief to a local Gemini agent through A2A. Preserve task state, decisions, open questions, provenance and scoped lease semantics.
Use an existing desktop interface with Gemini CLI and a plug-in MCP gateway. Authenticate through the official CLI. Treat account entitlements as a runtime capability check.
Transfer only approved technical project context. Default-deny all unrelated context and capabilities. Keep policy and review credentials outside model-writable directories.
